'''January 2001 Pleasanton tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Pleasanton, California on 20 January 2001. [[Kevin Shannon]] won it. It is known from Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1653">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-21-pleasanton-ca-1-20-01d1653/ pleasanton-ca-1-20-01], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 21 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-21-pleasanton-ca-1-20-01d1653/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Pleasanton, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 19
* '''Winner:''' [[Kevin Shannon]]

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Alfred Dong gives about 17 players and thinks Jeff Field finished 2nd; Nick Stefanko's report gives 19 players, Shawn Ely 2nd and Jeff Field 3rd.<ref name="tr-d1668" />
